security.title: Privacy and security
security.protectedContentBody: Lessons on this platform are streamed, not downloaded. Screenshots and screen recording are blocked while protected content is on screen, and every playback session carries a watermark linked to your account.
security.deviceBindingBody: Your account works on one authorized device. This protects your account and the instructors' work.
security.watermarkBody: Your name and account ID are displayed during playback. Redistributing recorded lessons can be traced back to the account that made them.
security.reportBody: If something isn't working, contact the administration.
security.shieldBody: Protected content is hidden while the app is in the background or a capture is in progress.
security.integrityBody: Protected lessons can't be played on rooted, jailbroken or emulated devices.
